label: DUF262 Schlafen system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded, DUF262-associated prokaryotic Schlafen nuclease locus.
observations: DUF262-associated Schlafen branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Schlafen proteins, individual prokaryotic schlafen genes, non-DUF262 Schlafen nuclease architectures, general DUF262-domain activities, and the DefenseFinder DUF262_Shlafen source key outside a complete organism-level system.
